scripts.check: oxfmt --check && bun run lint && tools/check-lint-disables.sh && tools/check-layers.sh && tsc --noEmit && bun test && ! grep -rn '^import qs\.' gui && /usr/lib/qt6/bin/qmllint gui/*.qml gui/theme/*.qml gui/controls/*.qml gui/components/*.qml && /usr/lib/qt6/bin/qmllint -I "${OMARCHY_PATH:-/usr/share/omarchy}/shell" omarchy/*.qml && shellcheck install.sh .claude/hooks/fix-and-format.sh tools/*.sh && [ "$(jq -r .version manifest.json)" = "$(jq -r .version package.json)" ] && bun run validate-plugin
scripts.validate-plugin: d=$(mktemp -d) && git clone -q . "$d/plugin" && omarchy-plugin-validate "$d/plugin"; s=$?; rm -rf "$d"; exit $s
